description: This is an integration test class for the PolicyPersistenceOperationsActor, which verifies the persistence and retrieval of policy entities within a MongoDB-backed system using Akka actors.

classes.name: PolicyPersistenceOperationsActorIT
classes.description: Integration test class for PolicyPersistenceOperationsActor, extending MongoEventSourceITAssertions to test policy persistence and retrieval.

methods.name: purgeNamespaceWithoutSuffix
methods.description: Test method to verify purging a namespace without suffix.

methods.name: purgeEntitiesWithNamespace

methods.description: Returns resource type associated with policies.
